subject: Stellarsys campus demo — access & NDA checklist
messages:
From: Ava Morrison <ava.morrison@stellarsys.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: security@stellarsys.com
Date: 2028-07-01T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + request: on-site demo at Redwood HQ (NDA attached)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the quick call today — our product and procurement teams are excited to see a live run of the integration. We'd like to schedule an on-site demo at Redwood HQ in Novato for our 6-person evaluation pod. Primary dates we have available: July 18–20 or July 25 (all day).

Could you confirm:
- Whether Redwood requires a signed NDA in advance (we've attached a draft).
- Visitor badging/parking process and any escort requirements.
- AV set-up (projector + mics) and room capacity.

I've attached our standard mutual NDA (Stellarsys_NDA_Draft_v2.pdf). Please loop in the person who handles visitor logistics and anyone who needs to countersign.

Would prefer July 19 if possible — let me know availability and any required pre-visit paperwork.

Best,
Ava Morrison
Senior Product Manager
Stellarsys

Attachments: Stellarsys_NDA_Draft_v2.pdf

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Ava Morrison <ava.morrison@stellarsys.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: on-site demo at Redwood HQ (NDA attached)

Hi Ava — great to hear. July 19 works for us; provisional hold placed on 4 conference rooms to match group size and breakout plans. A few quick notes and asks: 

- NDA: yes, we prefer DocuSign for countersignatures. Please send the DocuSign link or confirm we can upload your PDF. We will also send our standard visitor addendum for anyone accessing restricted racks (usually an internal one-pager).

- Badging & escort: Redwood requires visitor badges for all external guests and an internal escort while on the secure floors. Evelyn will handle escort coverage and badging.

- Parking: We can reserve a day-pass for two vehicles in visitor lot A; please let us know license plates the morning of arrival or we can issue QR passes.

- AV: projector + HDMI, one wireless lapel mic, and room recording are available if you want it captured. Marissa will confirm the AV checklist and whether you need a dedicated laptop.

- Catering: light breakfast and lunch can be ordered; dietary restrictions?

Proposed schedule (draft):
09:30 — arrivals, badging, coffee
10:00 — 60m demo (main room)
11:15 — 45m breakout (integration Q&A + security)
12:15 — lunch
13:30 — 60m procurement/pricing and next steps

If that looks good I'll send a calendar invite and DocuSign for the NDA. Looping Evelyn and Marissa to confirm logistics.

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, Ava Morrison <ava.morrison@stellarsys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-03T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: on-site demo at Redwood HQ (NDA attached)

Hi all — I'll own on-site logistics for July 19. Quick confirmations from ops: 

- Room: Cantor Conf A (capacity 30) reserved 09:00–14:30. AV: HDMI, Apple TV, 1 lapel + 1 handheld mic. I'll bring our meeting laptop and a spare adapter pack. See attached runbook (redwood-hq-visitor-runbook.pdf) for arrival flow.

- Badging: Emailed badge QR codes are preferred. If guests cannot use QR, we will check in with a government ID. Escort schedule: Marissa will escort the first half (demo + security breakout); I'll cover procurement session.

- Security paperwork: For any engineers who need rack access, fill the short addendum; I will bring printed copies. Otherwise no rack tours planned.

- Catering: Coffee/tea, GF options, and boxed lunches. Ava, please reply with dietary restrictions by EOD July 9.

- DocuSign NDA: Rafael — if you can publish the countersign request, I will route to Legal for the addendum review. Otherwise, Ava, feel free to send your DocuSign link and we will countersign.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Program Manager, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-hq-visitor-runbook.pdf, AV-checklist-Redwood.pdf

- Final headcount: 6 (Ava Morrison, Priya Shah, Tom Benson, Lisa Wu, Raj Patel, security@stellarsys.com)
- Dietary: 1 vegetarian, 1 gluten-free.
- Parking: we'd like the QR passes; please send the QR links the morning of.

Also looping Venue Ops to confirm the garage access — ops@novato-conference.com can coordinate onsite signage.

See you on the 19th — please share the calendar invite when you have it.

— Ava
